name: asset_id
label: Source asset ID
help: The original in your Etchv asset library, such as the source of a file you watermarked.

name: name
label: Link name
help: Shown to recipients on the page they open. Up to 200 characters.

name: recipients
label: Recipients
help: Email addresses only, without names, up to 100. Give recipients or allowed domains, not both.

name: allowed_domains
label: Allowed domains
help: Anyone with a confirmed email at exactly one of these domains may open the link, up to 10.

name: expires_at
label: Expires at
help: Default 30 days from now, or sooner if the source file expires first. At most a year.

name: prepare
label: Make copies
help: Leave empty for the default: all at once for video and PDFs over 5 pages. Links for allowed domains always make copies when opened.

name: download_limit
label: Downloads per recipient
help: 1 to 100. Leave empty for no limit.

name: webhook_id
label: Webhook ID
help: An Etchv webhook endpoint that receives an event each time a recipient opens the link.

name: idempotency_key
label: Idempotency key
help: Map a stable source event ID. Reuse the same value on retry to get the same link back.
